item.name: Crow (Black Fire)
item.obtainment: Limited Villain Banner summons (about 0.01% rate, pity around 10,000 pulls), then evolve from Crow.
item.passive: Regular attacks apply Illusion for a short window. While Illusion lasts, damage this unit deals is stored and released at reduced strength in a small AoE when Illusion ends. Searing Flames lets Black Fire chew through shields and stacks Black Fire on shielded enemies in range.
item.evolution: Evolved form of Crow. Requires Crow's Ring, red, yellow, and purple Evolution Sprites, 3 Rainbow Sprites, and 10,000 gold.
item.cardSummary: Limited Secret Magical carry that stores Illusion damage and pressures shields with Black Fire.

item.name: 8th Sword (Berserk)
item.obtainment: Evolve from 8th Sword. Base form drops from Spirit City Raid Act 3 (about 1% chance, pity around 35 clears), then evolve in the Upgrades room.
item.passive: Shinigami Sword raises damage for each enemy in range up to a cap. Demonic Presence deals steady burn-style damage to enemies in the inner part of its range. Savage Rebound cleanses its own stun with a Thunderclap Cut follow-up that applies Dismembered. Dismemberer's Rush punishes enemies below 10% health with another follow-up. After 25 takedowns, The Nameless Demon enters Berserk for a short damage, SPA, and Dismembered window.
item.evolution: Evolved form of 8th Sword. Requires red, blue, and green Evolution Sprites, 3 Rainbow Sprites, and 10,000 gold.
item.cardSummary: Secret Physical carry that ramps through takedowns and spikes hard once Berserk is online.

item.name: Shadow (Divine)
item.obtainment: Evolve from Shadow. Base form comes from Standard or Mini banner after Secret summons unlock around account level 10.
item.passive: Unlocks a circling Winged Spirit at upgrade 3 and an independently upgradeable Wolf Spirit at upgrade 5 for extra damage and stun pressure.
item.activeAbility: Shadow Realm rewinds enemies in range and grants Magical units a 25% damage buff for 30 seconds (global cooldown). Divine Spirit summons a permanent spirit equal to base damage while stunning Shadow itself.
item.evolution: Evolved form of Shadow. Requires blue, green, and red Evolution Sprites, 3 Rainbow Sprites, and 10,000 gold.
item.cardSummary: Secret Magical summoner that buffs allied Magical units and adds lasting spirit damage.

item.name: Crimson (Brother)
item.obtainment: Exclusive route through Battle Pass, tournaments, or other limited activities rather than the open banner pool.
item.passive: Regular attacks apply Crimson Mark so marked enemies explode after a few seconds. Explosions leave crimson pools that keep damaging enemies standing in them.
item.activeAbility: Piercing Crimson channels toward a chosen point for about 10 seconds, dealing repeated damage and applying Crimson Mark while this unit cannot use regular attacks.
item.evolution: Evolved form of Crimson. Requires red and pink Evolution Sprites, 1 Rainbow Sprite, and 5,000 gold.
item.cardSummary: Exclusive Magical DoT unit that marks enemies, detonates them, and leaves damaging pools.

item.name: Toy Maker
item.obtainment: Exclusive rewards such as tournaments or limited-time activities rather than the standard banner pool.
item.passive: Summons toys on paths in range instead of normal attacking. Toys scale from this unit’s damage, can gain speed and death AoE as upgrades progress, and later cycles can create tougher mutated toys. Health is split when covering multiple paths.
item.evolution: Listed as this Exclusive form in unit tables. No separate base-to-evo recipe found in the nine-row evolution guides.
item.cardSummary: Exclusive summoner that floods paths with toys instead of using a standard attack loop.

item.name: True Saint (Holy)
item.obtainment: Beginner Path and exclusive progression rewards. Often one of the first strong limited units new accounts can secure.
item.passive: Regular attacks apply True Saint Mark to a small group of enemies. Critical attacks spend all marks to deal bonus damage to each marked target, and upgrades raise critical chance.
item.activeAbility: Seize steals a portion of damage from the three strongest allies in range for a long window, concentrating power on this unit.
item.evolution: Evolved form of True Saint. Requires a Holy Pendant, multi-color Evolution Sprites, 1 Rainbow Sprite, and 5,000 gold.
item.cardSummary: Beginner-friendly Exclusive that marks targets and can steal ally damage for a burst window.

item.name: Cursed Immortal (Black Sun)
item.obtainment: Limited Villain Banner summons (about 0.25% rate, pity around 400 pulls), then evolve from Cursed Immortal.
item.passive: Walks the path without trading collision damage and instead damages enemies inside an aura. A Black Magic meter swings between Caring State (wider, lower tick damage) and Cold State (tighter, higher tick damage). Changing state also raises critical chance up to a cap.
item.evolution: Evolved form of Cursed Immortal. Requires a Cursed Book, purple and blue Evolution Sprites, 1 Rainbow Sprite, and 10,000 gold.
item.cardSummary: Limited Mythic path-walker that pulses aura damage while flipping between Caring and Cold Black Magic states.

item.name: Dark Mage (Sovereign)
item.obtainment: Limited Villain Banner summons (about 0.25% rate, pity around 400 pulls), then evolve from Dark Mage.
item.passive: After several regular attacks, cycles between Ice Magic (circle AoE with Freeze buildup) and Lightning Magic (cone AoE). Switching to Lightning places a damaging arc on the path; switching to Ice enables Freeze on attack and Frostbite stacks that can shatter frozen targets for bonus AoE damage.
item.evolution: Evolved form of Dark Mage. Requires a Magical Amulet, red and yellow Evolution Sprites, 1 Rainbow Sprite, and 10,000 gold.
item.cardSummary: Limited Mythic Magical hybrid that swaps Ice Freeze pressure with Lightning path DoT.

item.name: Razorjaw (Hunter)
item.obtainment: Limited Villain Banner summons (about 0.25% rate, pity around 400 pulls), then evolve from Razorjaw.
item.passive: Periodically unleashes a full-AoE Roar that damages enemies, applies Stagger, and permanently raises critical chance per enemy hit up to a cap.
item.activeAbility: Endless Slashes (unlocks on a late upgrade) teleports this unit to base and slashes down the whole path with rising damage per slash, then returns to its placement.
item.evolution: Evolved form of Razorjaw. Requires a Jaw Skull, blue and green Evolution Sprites, 1 Rainbow Sprite, and 10,000 gold.
item.cardSummary: Limited Mythic Physical unit that staggers with Roar and can clear a lane with Endless Slashes.

item.name: Cursed Student (True Love)
item.obtainment: Beginner Banner and other Mythic banner pools during progression summons.
item.passive: Every third regular attack copies a follow-up based on the closest unit in range, mixing this unit's damage with a share of that unit's damage. Enough total Bleed stacks in range also spawn Bat Spirits that attack a few times before despawning.
item.evolution: Evolved form of Cursed Student. Requires a Student ID, blue and purple Evolution Sprites, 1 Rainbow Sprite, and 5,000 gold.
item.cardSummary: Mythic Physical carry that mimics nearby ally attacks and summons bats from Bleed stacks.

item.name: Elf Mage (Unleashed)
item.obtainment: Beginner Banner and other Mythic banner pools during progression summons.
item.passive: Gains Arcane Charges on regular attacks up to a small capacity. Thresholds cast line, circle, and full AoE follow-up spells, and each charge reset permanently boosts Arcane Spell damage up to a stack cap.
item.evolution: Evolved form of Elf Mage. Requires Cosmic Magic, blue and purple Evolution Sprites, 1 Rainbow Sprite, and 5,000 gold.
item.cardSummary: Mythic Magical caster that stacks charges into stronger AoE follow-up spells over a fight.

item.name: Flame Emperor (Reincarnate)
item.obtainment: Beginner Banner and other Mythic banner pools during progression summons.
item.passive: When this unit applies Burn, the burn spreads to several nearest non-burning enemies for extra wave pressure.
item.activeAbility: Wall of Fire places a burning wall on a path in range so enemies that pass through are inflicted with Burn.
item.evolution: Evolved form of Flame Emperor. Requires a Burning Fruit, red and yellow Evolution Sprites, 1 Rainbow Sprite, and 5,000 gold.
item.cardSummary: Mythic Flame unit that spreads Burn and can seal a path with a fire wall.

item.name: Hollow (Blaze)
item.obtainment: Beginner Banner and other Mythic banner pools during progression summons.
item.passive: Converts Burn applications on enemies in range into Austere Flames when burn ticks end or when this unit attacks a burning target, dealing a large share of current damage as follow-up flame damage. Works best with burn partners.
item.evolution: Listed as this form in unit tables. No separate base-to-evo recipe found in the nine-row evolution guides.
item.cardSummary: Mythic Physical flame unit that converts Burn into extra Austere Flames damage.

item.name: Lady Giant (Envy)
item.obtainment: Beginner Banner and other Mythic banner pools during progression summons.
item.passive: Regular attacks build Rock Chunks that become a rock follow-up throw. Can also summon Stone Walls with health based on current damage, and Giant form changes wall and rock values.
item.activeAbility: Size Control transforms this unit into Giant form for a timed window, greatly raising damage and range while slowing attack speed.
item.evolution: Listed as this form in unit tables. No separate base-to-evo recipe found in the nine-row evolution guides.
item.cardSummary: Mythic Terra bruiser that throws rock follow-ups, raises walls, and can transform into a giant.

item.name: Puppet (Telekinetic)
item.obtainment: Beginner Banner and other Mythic banner pools during progression summons.
item.passive: Periodically marks the strongest unmarked enemy in range so that target takes increased incoming damage. When a marked enemy dies, summons a durable Doll based on this unit’s damage.
item.activeAbility: Complete Control rewinds all enemies in range by a short time window after it unlocks at a later upgrade.
item.evolution: Evolved form of Puppet. Requires a Puppet Heart, pink and purple Evolution Sprites, 1 Rainbow Sprite, and 5,000 gold.
item.cardSummary: Mythic Psychic hybrid that amplifies a marked target, summons a doll, and can rewind waves.

item.name: Reaper (Released)
item.obtainment: Standard or Mini banner and other Mythic pools during progression summons.
item.passive: Permanently gains damage and critical chance after attacking different enemy types. Critical hits can temporarily lower SPA, and stun interactions can swap with a Mirage clone when one exists.
item.activeAbility: Mirage Step relocates this unit within range and leaves a Mirage clone that deals a share of base damage.
item.evolution: Listed as this form in unit tables. No separate base-to-evo recipe found in the nine-row evolution guides.
item.cardSummary: Mythic Physical carry that self-buffs from enemy variety and repositions with Mirage Step.

item.name: Salmon Sorcerer (Grade 1)
item.obtainment: Beginner Banner and other Mythic banner pools during progression summons.
item.passive: Applies a 20% Slow through upgrades. When enemies enter the inner half of range, Plummet applies Stagger for a short stun-style interrupt.
item.evolution: Evolved form of Salmon Sorcerer. Requires a Salmon item, green and blue Evolution Sprites, 1 Rainbow Sprite, and 5,000 gold.
item.cardSummary: Mythic control unit built around Slow and Stagger so damage dealers get more uptime.

item.name: String Demon (Awakened)
item.obtainment: Beginner Banner and other Mythic banner pools during progression summons.
item.passive: Regular attacks can cocoon hit enemies so they stay stunned until the cocoon is broken or times out, with a bonus damage payout if broken. String Sync also links nearby allies so their attacks can trigger follow-ups that deal this unit’s damage before the strings break.
item.evolution: Evolved form of String Demon. Requires Joker of the Nonsensical Pirates, yellow and pink Evolution Sprites, 1 Rainbow Sprite, and 5,000 gold.
item.cardSummary: Mythic Magical hybrid that cocoons enemies for stall and links allies into follow-up attacks.
